description: This file defines a command class for exporting dashboard models in the Apache Superset project, including functions for generating filenames, content serialization, and exporting related charts, tags, themes, and datasets.

classes.name: ExportDashboardsCommand
classes.description: A command class for exporting dashboard models, including related charts, tags, themes, and datasets.

methods.name: _file_name
methods.description: Generates the filename for the exported dashboard YAML file based on dashboard title and ID.

methods.name: _file_content
methods.description: Serializes a Dashboard model into YAML format, including handling of JSON fields, native filters, orphan charts, theme, and tags.

methods.name: _export
methods.description: Generator method that yields filename and content for the dashboard and its related entities (charts, tags, theme, datasets).
